ui.keyboard: You can also use the ← → keys
ui.welcome:
One step at a time.
Clear and simple.
ui.welcomeBody: Animated slides for contract explanations and orientation. Pause to check contracts and related documents.
ui.readyBody: {{count}} slides. Change language at any time without losing your place.
ui.privacy: No sign-up. Just open your browser.
ui.storageError: Content cannot be saved in this browser. Showing the sample.
ui.noDocumentsBody: Related documents will appear here when they are added.
ui.studioBody: Import content created by a coding agent. Claude Code, Antigravity or Codex handles the script, diagrams and translation.
ui.importTitle: Start with a PDF or images
ui.importBody: Choose one PDF or PNG / JPEG / WebP images. Slides follow filename order. Up to 30 MB total and 60 pages.
ui.jsonBody: Load a guide.bundle.json with text, translations, links, and animations.
ui.resetConfirm: Delete saved content and restore the sample?
ui.localDraftBody: Imported content stays in this device’s browser. To share it, export JSON and add it to the project.
ui.sourceNote: PDFs and images display whole pages. To create animated elements, open this project in a coding agent and provide your source material and brief.
ui.importError: Could not import. Check the file format and contents.
ui.exportBody: Save the current guide with its images and translations.
guide.title: Your first guide
guide.description: Choose your language and explore the information, one step at a time.
slide.welcome.label: START HERE
slide.welcome.title:
At your own pace.
One step at a time.
slide.welcome.body: Read the explanations and open related documents whenever you need them. You can revisit any slide.
slide.language.label: IN YOUR LANGUAGE
slide.language.title:
Switch to the language
you feel comfortable with.
slide.language.body: Use the language menu at the top. You will stay on the slide you are reading.
slide.language.item1.title: Choose a language
slide.language.item1.body: Japanese, English, Nepali, and Vietnamese are available.
slide.language.item2.title: Keep your place
slide.language.item2.body: Changing language does not take you back to the beginning.
slide.steps.label: HOW IT WORKS
slide.steps.title:
Read. Check.
Move forward.
slide.steps.body: Use buttons or swipe on your phone. Choose the way that works for you.
slide.steps.item1.title: Read the guide
slide.steps.item1.body: Use “Next” to advance one slide at a time.
slide.steps.item2.title: Check documents
slide.steps.item2.body: Open related documents when you need them.
slide.steps.item3.title: Return to your place
slide.steps.item3.body: “Back to the guide” takes you to the same slide.
slide.documents.label: WHEN YOU NEED THEM
slide.documents.title:
Your related documents,
all in one place.
slide.documents.body: Collect PDF and web page links on the documents page. Try opening the sample document.
slide.complete.label: ALL DONE
slide.complete.title:
You are
ready to go.
slide.complete.body: Use the contents to revisit any slide. Find the information you need, whenever you need it.
document.sample.title: Sample document
document.sample.body: A PDF for testing. Replace it with your actual document.
document.help.title: Sample web page
document.help.body: Opens MDN’s web documentation. Replace it with your own destination.
ui.rotate: Turn your phone sideways to view the slides.
ui.agentTitle: Create from source material with a coding agent.
ui.agentBody: Open this project in Claude Code, Antigravity or Codex. Provide the script and the instruction below. The agent prepares the scenes, diagrams, translations and narration; this app plays them.
